conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie to the model, set up Claude Code with Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Galende 1994 p. 163 names the letter: Micer May, ambassador in Rome, to the Comendador Mayor de León, 12 Sept 1531, leg. 853 fol. 85.
Tomokiyo's AGS Estado page has a hidden comment on R9960: 'no cipher'.
Fetched both R9960 images (AGS scans 002-003) with the shared cookie.
Viewed both pages at full resolution: clear Spanish decipherment, heading 'De micer may xij de sete 1531', margin letter A; no cipher sign. Transcribed.

outcome.method_basis: The DECODE record R9960 holds no cipher: both pages are the contemporary clear decipherment ('De micer may xij de set[iembr]e 1531', block A) of a despatch not on DECODE, as Tomokiyo's hidden 'no cipher' note had said.
outcome.notes: Not a cipher: the record is the clear decipherment of Mai's despatch. Catalogue entry 204 removed; no write-up.
